examples.text: evam'etassa kevalassa dukkhakkhandhassa samudayo hoti.

18102.meaning1: so it is; just like that; exactly like that
18102.commentary: (SNa) evam'etaṃ, mahārājā'ti idha bhagavā imaṃ suttaṃ sabbaññubhāsitaṃ karonto āha.

examples.text: evam'etaṃ bhaginiyo evam'etaṃ bhaginiyo!
ākiñcaññasambhavaṃ ñatvā, nandī saṃyojanaṃ iti, evam'etaṃ abhiññāya, tato tattha vipassati, etaṃ ñāṇaṃ tathaṃ tassa, brāhmaṇassa vusīmato'ti.

18103.commentary: (MNa) evam'etāsaṃ diṭṭhīnaṃ pahānaṃ hotī'ti evaṃ viggah'ādi-ādīnavaṃ disvā tāsaṃ diṭṭhīnaṃ pahānaṃ hoti.

examples.text: iti so viggahañ'ca vivādañ'ca vighātañ'ca vihesañ'ca attani sampassamāno tañ'c'eva diṭṭhiṃ pajahati aññañ'ca diṭṭhiṃ na upādiyati. evam'etāsaṃ diṭṭhīnaṃ pahānaṃ hoti, evam'etāsaṃ diṭṭhīnaṃ paṭinissaggo hoti.
tatra, bhikkhave, y'āyaṃ upekkhā ekattā ekattasitā taṃ nissāya taṃ āgamma y'āyaṃ upekkhā nānattā nānattasitā taṃ pajahatha, taṃ samatikkamatha. evam'etissā pahānaṃ hoti, evam'etissā samatikkamo hoti.

tatra, bhikkhave, yāni cha nekkhammasitāni somanassāni tāni nissāya tāni āgamma yāni cha gehasitāni somanassāni tāni pajahatha, tāni samatikkamatha. evam'etesaṃ pahānaṃ hoti, evam'etesaṃ samatikkamo hoti.
evam'etesaṃ, bhikkhave, sutt'antānaṃ tathāgatabhāsitānaṃ gambhīrānaṃ gambhīr'atthānaṃ lok'uttarānaṃ suññatappaṭisaṃyuttānaṃ antaradhānaṃ bhavissati.

18107.meaning1: like this here; thus in this case

examples.text: bhaddakā vat'ime sunāparantakā manussā, subhaddakā vat'ime sunāparantakā manussā, yaṃ me na'y'ime pāṇinā pahāraṃ dentī'ti. evam'ettha, bhagavā, bhavissati, evam'ettha, sugata, bhavissatī'ti.
evamesā kasī kaṭṭhā, sā hoti amatapphalā, etaṃ kasiṃ kasitvāna, sabbadukkhā pamuccatī'ti.

18109.meaning1: similarly; in the same way; so too; just so

examples.text: atītam'p'āhaṃ addhānaṃ evam'eva rūpena khajjiṃ, seyyathā'pi eta'r'ahi paccuppannena rūpena khajjāmi
evam'eva kho, poṭṭhapāda, ye te samaṇabrāhmaṇā evaṃvādino evaṃdiṭṭhino, ek'antasukhī attā hoti arogo paraṃ maraṇā'ti.

18110.meaning1: similarly; in the same way; so too

examples.text: evam'eva kho, bhikkhave, bhikkhu sīlaṃ nissāya sīle patiṭṭhāya satta bojjh'aṅge bhāveti, satta bojjh'aṅge bahulīkaroti.
evam'eva kho, bhikkhave, yassa kassaci bhikkhuno kāyagatāsati abhāvitā abahulīkatā, taṃ cakkhu āviñchati manāpiyesu rūpesu, amanāpiyā rūpā paṭikūlā honti

18111.meaning1: similarly indeed; truly in the same way; in exactly the same way

examples.text: seyyathā'pi nāma āsītikapabbāni vā kāḷapabbāni vā, evam'ev'assu me aṅgapaccaṅgāni bhavanti tāy'ev'app'āhāratāya. seyyathā'pi nāma oṭṭhapadaṃ, evam'ev'assu me ānisadaṃ hoti tāy'ev'app'āhāratāya.

18112.meaning1: similarly; in exactly the same way; so too

examples.text: maṃ ce'pi tumhe, bhikkhave, etam'atthaṃ paṭipuccheyyātha, aham'pi taṃ evam'evaṃ byākareyyaṃ yathā taṃ mahākaccānena byākataṃ

seyyathā'pi, bhante, nikkujjitaṃ vā ukkujjeyya, paṭicchannaṃ vā vivareyya, mūḷhassa vā maggaṃ ācikkheyya, andhakāre vā telapajjotaṃ dhāreyya, cakkhumanto rūpāni dakkhantī'ti. evam'evaṃ bhagavatā anekapariyāyena dhammo pakāsito.

18113.meaning1: similarly this; in the same way this; so too he; just so he

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, bho gotama, gaṅgā nadī samuddaninnā samuddapoṇā samuddapabbhārā samuddaṃ āhacca tiṭṭhati, evam'ev'āyaṃ bhoto gotamassa parisā sagahaṭṭhapabbajitā nibbānaninnā nibbānapoṇā nibbānapabbhārā nibbānaṃ āhacca tiṭṭhati.

18114.meaning1: likewise; just like this; similarly; so too

examples.text: yathā'pi mūle anupaddave daḷhe, chinno'pi rukkho punareva rūhati, evam'pi taṇh'ānusaye anūhate, nibbattatī dukkham'idaṃ punappunaṃ.
supinena yathā'pi saṅgataṃ, paṭibuddho puriso na passati, evam'pi piyāyitaṃ janaṃ, petaṃ kālakataṃ na passati.

18115.meaning1: so captivating; so bewitching; so enchanting

examples.text: sannipatitvā taṃ saṅkhadhamaṃ etadavocuṃ, ambho, kassa nu kho eso evaṃrajanīyo evaṅkamanīyo evaṃmadanīyo evam'bandhanīyo evaṃmucchanīyo'ti.

18116.meaning1: such; similar kind of; of such quality

examples.text: idha mayhaṃ, bhante, evaṃ hoti, lābhā vata me, suladdhaṃ vata me, yo'haṃ evarūpehi sabrahmacārīhi saddhiṃ viharāmī'ti
evarūpo, bhikkhave, aḍḍhakahāpaṇena'pi bandhanaṃ nigacchati, kahāpaṇena'pi bandhanaṃ nigacchati, kahāpaṇasatena'pi bandhanaṃ nigacchati.

18117.meaning1: did such a thing; performed such an action

examples.text: māssu, bho satta, puna'pi evarūpam'akāsī'ti. aññe pāṇinā pahariṃsu, aññe leḍḍunā pahariṃsu, aññe daṇḍena pahariṃsu.

18118.meaning1: even such; even such kind of

examples.text: evarūpā'pi kho me, aggivessana, uppannā dukkhā vedanā cittaṃ na pariyādāya tiṭṭhati.

18119.grammar: adj, comp, fem nom sg of evarūpa
18119.meaning1: of such kind; of such quality

examples.text: ye kho te bhikkhū sekkhā apattamānasā anuttaraṃ yogakkhemaṃ patthayamānā viharanti tesu me ayaṃ evarūpī anusāsanī hoti.
evarūpe'pi, āvuso, puggale kāruññaṃ'y'eva upaṭṭhāpetabbaṃ anuddayā'y'eva upaṭṭhāpetabbā anukampā'y'eva upaṭṭhāpetabbā
acchariyaṃ, bhikkhave, tathāgatassa, abbhutaṃ, bhikkhave, tathāgatassa! evarūpe'pi nāma sāvakayuge parinibbute n'atthi tathāgatassa soko vā paridevo vā!

18122.meaning1: just like that; exactly like this

examples.text: idha, bhikkhave, ekacco assakhaḷuṅko, pehī'ti vutto, viddho samāno codito sārathinā pacchato paṭikkamati, piṭṭhito rathaṃ pavatteti. evarūpo'pi, bhikkhave, idh'ekacco assakhaḷuṅko hoti. ayaṃ, bhikkhave, paṭhamo assadoso.

puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, idh'ekacco assakhaḷuṅko, pehī'ti vutto, viddho samāno codito sārathinā pacchā laṅghati, kubbaraṃ hanati, tidaṇḍaṃ bhañjati. evarūpo'pi, bhikkhave, idh'ekacco assakhaḷuṅko hoti. ayaṃ, bhikkhave, dutiyo assadoso.
ujugatam'ev'assa tasmiṃ samaye cittaṃ hoti sīlaṃ ārabbha.
amissīkatam'ev'assa cittaṃ hoti ṭhitaṃ āneñjappattaṃ vayañ'c'ass'ānupassati.
devo ca sammādhāraṃ anuppaveccheyya. ev'assu tāni, bhikkhave, bījāni vuddhiṃ viruḷhiṃ vepullaṃ āpajjeyyuṃ.

18126.meaning1: we see it like this; we understand it in this way
18126.meaningLit: it is like this for us here

examples.text: bhavapaccayā nu kho, bhikkhave, jāti, no vā, kathaṃ vā ettha hotī'ti? bhavapaccayā, bhante, jāti, evaṃ no ettha hoti, bhavapaccayā jātī'ti.

18127.meaning1: I see it like this; I understand it in this way
18127.meaningLit: it is like this for me here

examples.text: evaṃ me sutaṃ, ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati pubb'ārāme migāramātupāsāde
evaṃ me sutaṃ, ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā aṅgesu viharati assapuraṃ nāma aṅgānaṃ nigamo.

18129.meaning1: this being the case; this being so

examples.text: saññā nu kho, oḷāriko ca hi te, poṭṭhapāda, attā abhavissa rūpī cātumahābhūtiko kabaḷīkārāhārabhakkho. evaṃ santaṃ kho te, poṭṭhapāda, aññā'va saññā bhavissati añño attā.

yo, bhikkhave, evaṃ vadeyya, yathā yath'āyaṃ puriso kammaṃ karoti tathā tathā taṃ paṭisaṃvediyatī'ti, evaṃ santaṃ, bhikkhave, brahmacariyavāso na hoti, okāso na paññāyati sammā dukkhassa antakiriyāya.

18130.meaning1: in this situation; this being the case
18130.commentary: (ANa) evaṃ sant'āyaṃ, bhikkhave, puggalo akaccho hotī'ti, bhikkhave, etaṃ imasmiṃ ca kāraṇe sati ayaṃ puggalo na kathetuṃ yutto nāma hoti.

examples.text: sac'āyaṃ, bhikkhave, puggalo pañhaṃ puṭṭho samāno ek'aṃsabyākaraṇīyaṃ pañhaṃ na ek'aṃsena byākaroti, vibhajjabyākaraṇīyaṃ pañhaṃ na vibhajja byākaroti, paṭipucchābyākaraṇīyaṃ pañhaṃ na paṭipucchā byākaroti, ṭhapanīyaṃ pañhaṃ na ṭhapeti, evaṃ sant'āyaṃ, bhikkhave, puggalo akaccho hoti.

18131.meaning1: this being the case; this being so

examples.text: taṃ kiṃ maññasi, poṭṭhapāda, nanu evaṃ sante sappāṭihīrakataṃ bhāsitaṃ sampajjatī'ti? addhā kho, bhante, evaṃ sante sappāṭihīrakataṃ bhāsitaṃ sampajjatī'ti
evaṃ sante kho, uttara, andho bhāvit'indriyo bhavissati, badhiro bhāvit'indriyo bhavissati.
evaṃ vutte, so puggalo tuṇhī ahosi.
evaṃ vutte aññataro bhikkhu there bhikkhū etadavoca, phasso kho, āvuso, eko anto, phassasamudayo dutiyo anto, phassanirodho majjhe, taṇhā sibbinī.
ye pana te bhikkhū adhimānena aññaṃ byākaṃsu tatra, sunakkhatta, tathāgatassa evaṃ hoti, dhammaṃ nesaṃ desessan'ti.
tattha hatth'ārohassa evaṃ hoti, ayaṃ kho rañño nāgo īsādanto urūḷhavā abhijāto saṅgām'āvacaro saṅgāmagato… rakkhat'eva soṇḍaṃ.

18134.meaning1: thus; this; like this; similarly; in the same manner; just as; such

examples.text: evaṃ me sutaṃ, ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā ukkaṭṭhāyaṃ viharati subhagavane sālarājamūle. tatra kho bhagavā bhikkhū āmantesi, bhikkhavo'ti.
accī yathā vātavegena khittā, atthaṃ paleti na upeti saṅkhaṃ, evaṃ munī nāmakāyā vimutto, atthaṃ paleti na upeti saṅkhaṃ.
nanu te, bhikkhave, yāva'd'eva kantārassa nittharaṇ'atthāya āhāraṃ āhāreyyun'ti? evaṃ, bhante
bhabbo nu kho so puriso parittaṃ aggiṃ ujjālitun'ti? evaṃ, bhante.

18136.meaning1: having such intention; of such disposition

examples.text: yebhuyyena, bhikkhave, sattā evaṃkāmā evaṃchandā evaṃadhippāyā, aho vata aniṭṭhā akantā amanāpā dhammā parihāyeyyuṃ, iṭṭhā kantā manāpā dhammā abhivaḍḍheyyun'ti.

18137.meaning1: not past this; subject to this in future; yet to experience this

examples.text: so imam'eva kāyaṃ upasaṃharati, ayam'pi kho kāyo evaṃdhammo evaṃbhāvī evaṃanatīto'ti

18139.meaning1: just as easily; with as little difficulty as this

examples.text: evam'eva kho, ānanda, yassa kassaci evaṃsīghaṃ evaṃtuvaṭaṃ evaṃappakasirena uppannaṃ manāpaṃ uppannaṃ amanāpaṃ uppannaṃ manāp'āmanāpaṃ nirujjhati, upekkhā saṇṭhāti, ayaṃ vuccat'ānanda, ariyassa vinaye anuttarā indriyabhāvanā cakkhuviññeyyesu rūpesu.

18140.meaning1: having such a future state; with such a future destination
18140.meaning2: such a future state; such a future destination
18140.commentary: (DNa) evaṃ abhisamparāyā'ti idaṃ purimapadass'eva vevacanaṃ, evaṃvidhaparalokā'ti vuttaṃ hoti.

examples.text: ta'y'idaṃ, bhikkhave, tathāgato pajānāti, ime diṭṭhiṭṭhānā evaṃgahitā evaṃparāmaṭṭhā evaṃgatikā bhavanti evaṃabhisamparāyā'ti, tañ'ca tathāgato pajānāti, tato ca uttaritaraṃ pajānāti, tañ'ca pajānanaṃ na parāmasati, aparāmasato c'assa paccattaññ'eva nibbuti viditā.

18142.meaning1: so desirable; so pleasurable; so enticing

examples.text: tam'enaṃ evaṃ vadeyyuṃ, esā, kho, bhante, vīṇā nāma, yassā eso saddo evaṃrajanīyo evaṃkamanīyo evaṃmadanīyo evaṃmucchanīyo evaṃbandhanīyo'ti.

18143.meaning1: having such desire; with such wish

examples.text: yebhuyyena, bhikkhave, sattā evaṃkāmā evaṃchandā evaṃadhippāyā, aho vata aniṭṭhā akantā amanāpā dhammā parihāyeyyuṃ, iṭṭhā kantā manāpā dhammā abhivaḍḍheyyun'ti.

18144.meaning1: acting like this; doing such things

examples.text: evam'eva kho, bhikkhave, idh'ekacco bhikkhu gāmagato vā araññagato vā labhati vattāraṃ, ayañ'ca kho āyasmā evaṃkārī evaṃsamācāro asucigāmakaṇṭako'ti.
taṃ kiṃ maññatha, bhikkhave, api nu so puriso evaṃkārī tasmiṃ kulle kiccakārī assā'ti? no h'etaṃ, bhante.

18145.meaning2: in such a state; of such a kind

examples.text: yāni vā pan'aññāni'pi evaṃgatāni puthusipp'āyatanāni, te diṭṭh'eva dhamme sandiṭṭhikaṃ sippaphalaṃ upajīvanti, te tena attānaṃ sukhenti pīṇenti, mātāpitaro sukhenti pīṇenti, puttadāraṃ sukhenti pīṇenti

18146.meaning1: having such a destination; leading to such a destiny
18146.meaning2: producing or having a future course of this kind
18146.commentary: (DNa) evaṃgatikā'ti evaṃ niraya-tiracchāna-pettivisaya-gatikānaṃ aññataragatikā. (DNt) atha vā evaṃgatikā'ti evaṃgamanā, evaṃniṭṭhā'ti attho.

examples.text: ta'y'idaṃ, bhikkhave, tathāgato pajānāti, ime diṭṭhiṭṭhānā evaṃgahitā evaṃparāmaṭṭhā evaṃgatikā bhavanti evaṃabhisamparāyā'ti, tañ'ca tathāgato pajānāti, tato ca uttaritaraṃ pajānāti, tañ'ca pajānanaṃ na parāmasati, aparāmasato c'assa paccattaññ'eva nibbuti viditā.

18147.meaning1: held in such a way; thus grasped onto
18147.meaning2: held in such a way; thus grasped onto
18147.commentary: (DNa) evaṃgahitā'ti diṭṭhisaṅkhātā tāva diṭṭhiṭṭhānā, sassato attā ca loko cā'ti evaṃgahitā ādinnā, pavattitā'ti attho.

examples.text: ta'y'idaṃ, bhikkhave, tathāgato pajānāti, ime diṭṭhiṭṭhānā evaṃgahitā evaṃparāmaṭṭhā evaṃgatikā bhavanti evaṃabhisamparāyā'ti, tañ'ca tathāgato pajānāti, tato ca uttaritaraṃ pajānāti, tañ'ca pajānanaṃ na parāmasati, aparāmasato c'assa paccattaññ'eva nibbuti viditā.

18148.meaning1: of such family clan; of this lineage
18148.commentary: (VINa) evaṃgotto'ti bhaggavo vā gotamo vā (MNa) evaṃgotto'ti tāhi devatāhi saddhiṃ ekagotto.

examples.text: jānāsi taṃ janapadakalyāṇiṃ evaṃnāmā evaṃgottā'ti vā, dīghā vā rassā vā majjhimā vā kāḷī vā sāmā vā maṅguracchavī vā'ti, amukasmiṃ gāme vā nigame vā nagare vā'ti?
amutr'āsiṃ evaṃnāmo evaṃgotto evaṃvaṇṇo evam'āhāro evaṃsukhadukkhappaṭisaṃvedī evam'āyupariyanto

18149.meaning1: with the thought; with the idea

examples.text: yo hi koci, bhikkhave, bhikkhu evaṃcitto paresaṃ dhammaṃ deseti, aho vata me dhammaṃ suṇeyyuṃ, sutvā ca pana dhammaṃ pasīdeyyuṃ, pasannā ca me pasann'ākāraṃ kareyyun'ti, evarūpassa kho, bhikkhave, bhikkhuno aparisuddhā dhammadesanā hoti.

18150.meaning1: having such interest; of such inclination

examples.text: yebhuyyena, bhikkhave, sattā evaṃkāmā evaṃchandā evaṃadhippāyā, aho vata aniṭṭhā akantā amanāpā dhammā parihāyeyyuṃ, iṭṭhā kantā manāpā dhammā abhivaḍḍheyyun'ti.

18151.meaning1: of such and such a class; of this kind of family
18151.meaning2: of such and such a class; of this kind of family

examples.text: evaṃjaccā te bhagavanto ahesuṃ iti'pi, evaṃnāmā evaṃgottā evaṃsīlā evaṃdhammā evaṃpaññā evaṃvihārī evaṃvimuttā te bhagavanto ahesuṃ iti'pī'ti.

18152.meaning1: just as quickly; as immediately as this

examples.text: evam'eva kho, ānanda, yassa kassaci evaṃsīghaṃ evaṃtuvaṭaṃ evaṃappakasirena uppannaṃ manāpaṃ uppannaṃ amanāpaṃ uppannaṃ manāp'āmanāpaṃ nirujjhati, upekkhā saṇṭhāti, ayaṃ vuccat'ānanda, ariyassa vinaye anuttarā indriyabhāvanā cakkhuviññeyyesu rūpesu.

18153.meaning1: so brutal; so savage; as vicious as

18154.meaning1: having such a view; holding such an opinion
18154.commentary: (NIDD1a) evaṃdiṭṭhikā'ti evaṃladdhikā. yathā taṃ lābhādiṃ nibbattessāmā'ti evaṃ ayaṃ laddhi tesaṃ atthi, tathā atthi me vuttappakāro dhammo'ti etesaṃ khamati c'eva ruccati ca, evaṃsabhāvam'eva vā tesaṃ cittaṃ atthi me cittan'ti. tadā tesaṃ diṭṭhi vā, diṭṭhiyā saha khanti vā, diṭṭhikhantīhi saddhiṃ ruci vā, diṭṭhikhantirucīhi saddhiṃ laddhi vā, diṭṭhikhantiruciladdhīhi saddhiṃ ajjhāsayo vā, diṭṭhikhantiruciladdhiajjhāsayehi saddhiṃ adhippāyo vā hotī'ti dassento evaṃdiṭṭhikā… evaṃadhippāyā'ti āha.

examples.text: api ca kho evaṃdiṭṭhikā ahesuṃ, sassato loko iti'pi, asassato loko iti'pi, antavā loko iti'pi, anantavā loko iti'pi, taṃ jīvaṃ taṃ sarīraṃ iti'pi, aññaṃ jīvaṃ aññaṃ sarīraṃ iti'pi, hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇā iti'pi

yaṃ te titthiyā sundariparibbājikaṃ hantvā samaṇānaṃ sakyaputtiyānaṃ avaṇṇaṃ pakāsayitvā evaṃ etaṃ lābhaṃ yasasakkāraṃ sammānaṃ paccāharissāmā'ti te evaṃdiṭṭhikā evaṃkhantikā evaṃrucikā evaṃladdhikā evaṃajjhāsayā evaṃadhippāyā

18155.meaning1: of such a view; who holds the theory that; of the opinion that; who thinks that
18155.commentary: (UDa) evaṃ idāni vattabb'ākārena pavattā diṭṭhi etesan'ti evaṃdiṭṭhino.

examples.text: evam'eva kho, poṭṭhapāda, ye te samaṇabrāhmaṇā evaṃvādino evaṃdiṭṭhino, ek'antasukhī attā hoti arogo paraṃ maraṇā'ti.
ahañ'hi, bho gotama, evaṃvādī evaṃdiṭṭhī, yo koci diṭṭhaṃ bhāsati, evaṃ me diṭṭhan'ti, n'atthi tato doso

18156.meaning1: living for so long; having such a long lifespan

examples.text: ko pan'etaṃ bhoto kassapassa āroceti, atthi devā tāvatiṃsā'ti vā evaṃdīgh'āyukā devā tāvatiṃsā'ti vā.

18158.meaning1: of such nature; of such character
18158.commentary: (MNa) evaṃdhammo'ti ettha pana samādhipakkhikā dhammā dhammā'ti adhippetā.

examples.text: sa kho so, bhikkhave, bhikkhu evaṃsīlo evaṃdhammo evaṃpañño sālīnaṃ ce'pi piṇḍapātaṃ bhuñjati vicitakāḷakaṃ anekasūpaṃ anekabyañjanaṃ, n'ev'assa taṃ hoti antarāyāya.
so imam'eva kāyaṃ upasaṃharati, ayam'pi kho kāyo evaṃdhammo evaṃbhāvī evaṃanatīto'ti
ettha dāni mayaṃ there bhikkhū kiṃ vakkhāma, yatra hi nāma evaṃnavo bhikkhu satthāraṃ parirakkhitabbaṃ maññissati.

18161.commentary: (VINa) evaṃnāmo'ti vessantaro vā jotipālo vā. (MNa) evaṃnāmo'ti tatrā'pi tusitabhavane setaketu nāma devaputto ahosiṃ.

examples.text: jānāsi taṃ janapadakalyāṇiṃ evaṃnāmā evaṃgottā'ti vā, dīghā vā rassā vā majjhimā vā kāḷī vā sāmā vā maṅguracchavī vā'ti, amukasmiṃ gāme vā nigame vā nagare vā'ti?
amutr'āsiṃ evaṃnāmo evaṃgotto evaṃvaṇṇo evam'āhāro evaṃsukhadukkhappaṭisaṃvedī evam'āyupariyanto
vaṭajālikāyan'ti evaṃnāmake vihāre. so kira vaṭavane niviṭṭhattā vaṭajālikā'ti saṅkhaṃ gato.
sa kho so, bhikkhave, bhikkhu evaṃsīlo evaṃdhammo evaṃpañño sālīnaṃ ce'pi piṇḍapātaṃ bhuñjati vicitakāḷakaṃ anekasūpaṃ anekabyañjanaṃ, n'ev'assa taṃ hoti antarāyāya.

18165.meaning1: such a claim; such an assertion
18165.commentary: (ANt) evaṃpaṭiñño'ti salākaggahaṇ'ādīsu kittakā vihāre samaṇā'ti gaṇanāya āraddhāya aham'pi samaṇo, aham'pi samaṇo'ti paṭiññaṃ datvā salākaggahaṇ'ādīni karotī'ti samaṇo ahan'ti evaṃsamaṇappaṭiñño.

examples.text: tesaṃ vo, bhikkhave, evaṃsamaññānaṃ sataṃ evaṃpaṭiññānaṃ sataṃ ye dhammā samaṇakaraṇā ca brāhmaṇakaraṇā ca te dhamme samādāya vattissāma, evaṃ no ayaṃ amhākaṃ samaññā ca saccā bhavissati paṭiññā ca bhūtā.

18166.meaning1: practising like this; going along like this; who practices in such a way

examples.text: suppaṭipann'āttha, mārisā, ujuppaṭipann'āttha, mārisā, ek'antasukhassa lokassa sacchikiriyāya. mayam'pi hi, mārisā, evaṃpaṭipannā ek'antasukhaṃ lokaṃ upapannā'ti? iti puṭṭhā no'ti vadanti.

etadaggaṃ, bhikkhave, imāsaṃ catunnaṃ paṭipadānaṃ yadidaṃ sukhā paṭipadā khipp'ābhiññā. evaṃpaṭipannā'pi kho, bhikkhave, santi sattā. evaṃpaṭipannānam'pi kho, bhikkhave, sattānaṃ atth'eva aññathattaṃ atthi vipariṇāmo.

18167.meaning1: clung to in such a way; thus adhered to
18167.meaning2: clung to in such a way; thus adhered to
18167.commentary: (DNa) evaṃparāmaṭṭhā'ti nirāsaṅkacittatāya punappunaṃ āmaṭṭhā parāmaṭṭhā, idam'eva saccaṃ, mogham'aññan'ti pariniṭṭhāpitā. kāraṇasaṅkhātā pana diṭṭhiṭṭhānā yathā gayhamānā diṭṭhiyo samuṭṭhāpenti, evaṃ ārammaṇavasena ca pavattanavasena ca āsevanavasena ca gahitā. anādīnavadassitāya punappunaṃ gahaṇavasena parāmaṭṭhā.

examples.text: ta'y'idaṃ, bhikkhave, tathāgato pajānāti, ime diṭṭhiṭṭhānā evaṃgahitā evaṃparāmaṭṭhā evaṃgatikā bhavanti evaṃabhisamparāyā'ti, tañ'ca tathāgato pajānāti, tato ca uttaritaraṃ pajānāti, tañ'ca pajānanaṃ na parāmasati, aparāmasato c'assa paccattaññ'eva nibbuti viditā.

18168.meaning1: having such faith; with confidence like this
18168.meaning2: having such faith; having such confidence

examples.text: uḷārā kho te ayaṃ, sāriputta, āsabhī vācā bhāsitā, ek'aṃso gahito, sīhanādo nadito, evaṃpasanno ahaṃ, bhante, bhagavati, na c'āhu na ca bhavissati na c'eta'r'ahi vijjati añño samaṇo vā brāhmaṇo vā bhagavatā bhiyyo'bhiññataro yadidaṃ sambodhiyan'ti.

18169.meaning1: so captivating; so bewitching; so enchanting

examples.text: tam'enaṃ evaṃ vadeyyuṃ, esā, kho, bhante, vīṇā nāma, yassā eso saddo evaṃrajanīyo evaṃkamanīyo evaṃmadanīyo evaṃmucchanīyo evaṃbandhanīyo'ti.

18170.meaning1: yes indeed; exactly so; most certainly

examples.text: evaṃbyākho ahaṃ, āvuso, bhagavatā dhammaṃ desitaṃ ājānāmi yathā ye'me antarāyikā dhammā vuttā bhagavatā te paṭisevato n'ālaṃ antarāyāyā'ti.

evaṃ kho, aggivessana, bhagavā sāvake vineti, evaṃbhāgā ca pana bhagavato sāvakesu anusāsanī bahulā pavattati, rūpaṃ, bhikkhave, aniccaṃ, vedanā aniccā, saññā aniccā, saṅkhārā aniccā, viññāṇaṃ aniccaṃ.

18172.meaning1: destined for this; thus fated; going to be such

examples.text: so imam'eva kāyaṃ upasaṃharati, ayam'pi kho kāyo evaṃdhammo evaṃbhāvī evaṃanatīto'ti

18173.meaning1: like this; having such qualities; in such a state
18173.commentary: (ANa) evaṃbhūto'ti evaṃ paṭhamajjhān'ādīsu aññatarasamaṅgī hutvā. (ITIa) evaṃbhūto'ti evaṃ kāmavitakk'ādi-pāpavitakkehi samaṅgībhūto.

examples.text: so ce ahaṃ, brāhmaṇa, evaṃbhūto caṅkamāmi, dibbo me eso tasmiṃ samaye caṅkamo hoti. so ce ahaṃ, brāhmaṇa, evaṃbhūto tiṭṭhāmi, dibbaṃ me etaṃ tasmiṃ samaye ṭhānaṃ hoti. so ce ahaṃ, brāhmaṇa, evaṃbhūto nisīdāmi, dibbaṃ me etaṃ tasmiṃ samaye āsanaṃ hoti.
tañ'ce, bhikkhave, bhikkhu adhivāseti nappajahati na vinodeti na byantīkaroti anabhāvaṃ gameti. caram'pi, bhikkhave, bhikkhu evaṃbhūto anātāpī anottāpī satataṃ samitaṃ kusīto hīnavīriyo'ti vuccati.
tam'enaṃ evaṃ vadeyyuṃ, esā, kho, bhante, vīṇā nāma, yassā eso saddo evaṃrajanīyo evaṃkamanīyo evaṃmadanīyo evaṃmucchanīyo evaṃbandhanīyo'ti.

18175.meaning1: of such mighty power; of such mighty splendour; of such great majesty; of such great magnificence

examples.text: ākāse'pi pallaṅkena kameyyaṃ, seyyathā'pi pakkhī sakuṇo, ime'pi candimasūriye evaṃmah'iddhike evaṃmah'ānubhāve pāṇinā parāmaseyyaṃ parimajjeyyaṃ yāva brahmalokā'pi kāyena vasaṃ vatteyyan'ti

eso nu te, mārisa, so bhagavā satthā'ti? na kho me, mārisa, so bhagavā satthā. sabrahmacārī me eso āyasmā mahāmoggallāno'ti. lābhā te, mārisa, suladdhaṃ te, mārisa yassa te sabrahmacārī evaṃmah'iddhiko evaṃmah'ānubhāvo! aho nūna te so bhagavā satthā'ti.

18176.meaning1: of such great supernormal power; so magically powerful
18176.commentary: (MNa) evaṃmah'iddhikā'ti candimasūriyā kira ekappahāren'eva tīsu dīpesu paññāyanti, evaṃmah'iddhikā. ek'ekāya disāya nava-nava-yojana-satasahassāni andhakāraṃ vidhamitvā ālokaṃ dassenti, evaṃ mah'ānubhāvā.

examples.text: ākāse'pi pallaṅkena kameyyaṃ, seyyathā'pi pakkhī sakuṇo, ime'pi candimasūriye evaṃmah'iddhike evaṃmah'ānubhāve pāṇinā parāmaseyyaṃ parimajjeyyaṃ yāva brahmalokā'pi kāyena vasaṃ vatteyyan'ti

eso nu te, mārisa, so bhagavā satthā'ti? na kho me, mārisa, so bhagavā satthā. sabrahmacārī me eso āyasmā mahāmoggallāno'ti. lābhā te, mārisa, suladdhaṃ te, mārisa yassa te sabrahmacārī evaṃmah'iddhiko evaṃmah'ānubhāvo! aho nūna te so bhagavā satthā'ti.

18177.meaning1: overestimating oneself in such a manner; overrating oneself like this

examples.text: taṃ me taṇhāsallaṃ pahīnaṃ, apanīto avijjāvisadoso, sammā nibbān'ādhimutto'ham'asmī'ti. evaṃmāni assa atathaṃ samānaṃ.

18178.meaning1: so entrancing; so enchanting; so bewitching

examples.text: tam'enaṃ evaṃ vadeyyuṃ, esā, kho, bhante, vīṇā nāma, yassā eso saddo evaṃrajanīyo evaṃkamanīyo evaṃmadanīyo evaṃmucchanīyo evaṃbandhanīyo'ti.

18179.meaning1: so desirable; so arousing; so enticing

examples.text: tam'enaṃ evaṃ vadeyyuṃ, esā, kho, bhante, vīṇā nāma, yassā eso saddo evaṃrajanīyo evaṃkamanīyo evaṃmadanīyo evaṃmucchanīyo evaṃbandhanīyo'ti.

18180.meaning2: this-like or having such a form
18180.commentary: (MNa) evaṃrūpo'ti-ādīsu kāḷo'pi samāno indanīlamaṇivaṇṇo ahosin'ti evaṃ manuññarūpavasen'eva evaṃrūpo ahosiṃ.

examples.text: kathañ'ca, gahapati, purakkharāno hoti? idha, gahapati, ekaccassa evaṃ hoti, evaṃrūpo siyaṃ anāgatam'addhānaṃ, evaṃvedano siyaṃ anāgatam'addhānaṃ
evaṃrūpo ahosiṃ atītam'addhānan'ti, iti vā hi, bhikkhave, anussaramāno rūpaṃ'y'eva anussarati

18181.meaning2: having thus received the name; thus given the name

18182.meaning1: reached such a peak of material gain and fame
18182.sanskrit: evam + lābha + agra + yaśas + agra + prāpta

examples.text: yāvatā kho, cunda, eta'r'ahi satthāro loke uppannā, n'āhaṃ, cunda, aññaṃ ekasatthāram'pi samanupassāmi evaṃlābh'agga-yas'aggappattaṃ yathar'iv'āhaṃ.
yañ'hi'ssa, bhikkhave, anadhivāsayato uppajjeyyuṃ āsavā vighātapariḷāhā, adhivāsayato evaṃsa te āsavā vighātapariḷāhā na honti
yañ'hi'ssa, bhikkhave, avinodayato uppajjeyyuṃ āsavā vighātapariḷāhā, vinodayato evaṃsa te āsavā vighātapariḷāhā na honti. ime vuccanti, bhikkhave, āsavā vinodanā pahātabbā.

18184.meaning1: having such mental activity; having this kind of intention; having such thoughts
18184.commentary: (MNa) taṃsampayuttānaṃ'y'eva saññ'ādīnaṃ vasena evaṃsañño evaṃsaṅkhāro evaṃviññāṇo ahosiṃ atītam'addhānan'ti.

examples.text: evaṃsañño siyaṃ anāgatam'addhānaṃ, evaṃsaṅkhāro siyaṃ anāgatam'addhānaṃ, evaṃviññāṇo siyaṃ anāgatam'addhānan'ti. evaṃ kho, gahapati, purakkharāno hoti.
evaṃsaṅkhāro ahosiṃ atītam'addhānan'ti tattha nandiṃ samanvāneti, evaṃviññāṇo ahosiṃ atītam'addhānan'ti tattha nandiṃ samanvāneti, evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, atītaṃ anvāgameti.

18185.meaning1: having such recognition; having this kind of perception
18185.commentary: (MNa) taṃsampayuttānaṃ'y'eva saññ'ādīnaṃ vasena evaṃsañño evaṃsaṅkhāro evaṃviññāṇo ahosiṃ atītam'addhānan'ti.

examples.text: evaṃsañño siyaṃ anāgatam'addhānaṃ, evaṃsaṅkhāro siyaṃ anāgatam'addhānaṃ, evaṃviññāṇo siyaṃ anāgatam'addhānan'ti. evaṃ kho, gahapati, purakkharāno hoti.
evaṃrūpo ahosiṃ atītam'addhānan'ti tattha nandiṃ samanvāneti, evaṃvedano ahosiṃ atītam'addhānan'ti tattha nandiṃ samanvāneti, evaṃsañño ahosiṃ atītam'addhānan'ti tattha nandiṃ samanvāneti

18186.meaning1: of such perception; percipient in such a way

examples.text: puna caparaṃ, āvuso, bhikkhu sabbaso viññāṇ'añc'āyatanaṃ samatikkamma, n'atthi kiñcī'ti ākiñcaññ'āyatanaṃ upasampajja viharati. evaṃsaññī'pi kho, āvuso, tadāyatanaṃ no paṭisaṃvedetī'ti.
etadaggaṃ, bhikkhave, imesaṃ dasannaṃ kasiṇ'āyatanānaṃ yadidaṃ viññāṇakasiṇaṃ eko sañjānāti uddhaṃ adho tiriyaṃ advayaṃ appamāṇaṃ. evaṃsaññino'pi kho, bhikkhave, santi sattā.

18188.meaning1: of such repute; with such a reputation

18190.meaning1: such a designation; such a label

examples.text: tesaṃ vo, bhikkhave, evaṃsamaññānaṃ sataṃ evaṃpaṭiññānaṃ sataṃ ye dhammā samaṇakaraṇā ca brāhmaṇakaraṇā ca te dhamme samādāya vattissāma, evaṃ no ayaṃ amhākaṃ samaññā ca saccā bhavissati paṭiññā ca bhūtā.
evam'eva kho, bhikkhave, idh'ekacco bhikkhu gāmagato vā araññagato vā labhati vattāraṃ, ayañ'ca kho āyasmā evaṃkārī evaṃsamācāro asucigāmakaṇṭako'ti.
ayañ'ca kho āyasmā evaṃkārī evaṃsamācāro asucigāmakaṇṭako'ti. taṃ kaṇṭako'ti iti viditvā saṃvaro ca asaṃvaro ca veditabbo.

18192.meaning1: of such infamy; of such notoriety

18193.meaning1: just as quickly; so swiftly; as rapidly as this

examples.text: evam'eva kho, ānanda, yassa kassaci evaṃsīghaṃ evaṃtuvaṭaṃ evaṃappakasirena uppannaṃ manāpaṃ uppannaṃ amanāpaṃ uppannaṃ manāp'āmanāpaṃ nirujjhati, upekkhā saṇṭhāti, ayaṃ vuccat'ānanda, ariyassa vinaye anuttarā indriyabhāvanā cakkhuviññeyyesu rūpesu.

18194.meaning1: of such virtue; of such moral excellence

examples.text: sa kho so, bhikkhave, bhikkhu evaṃsīlo evaṃdhammo evaṃpañño sālīnaṃ ce'pi piṇḍapātaṃ bhuñjati vicitakāḷakaṃ anekasūpaṃ anekabyañjanaṃ, n'ev'assa taṃ hoti antarāyāya.

18195.meaning1: experiencing such ease and discomfort; feeling such kind of pleasure and pain

examples.text: amutr'āsiṃ evaṃnāmo evaṃgotto evaṃvaṇṇo evam'āhāro evaṃsukhadukkhapaṭisaṃvedī evam'āyupariyanto, so tato cuto amutra udapādiṃ

18196.meaning1: experiencing such pleasure and pain; feeling such ease and discomfort
18196.commentary: (VINa) evaṃ-sukhadukkha-ppaṭisaṃvedī'ti anekappakārena kāyikacetasikānaṃ sāmisanirāmis'ādippabhedānaṃ vā sukhadukkhānaṃ paṭisaṃvedī. (MNa) evaṃ-sukhadukkha-ppaṭisaṃvedī'ti evaṃ dibbasukhapaṭisaṃvedī. dukkhaṃ pana saṅkhāradukkhamattam'eva.

examples.text: so tato cuto amutra udapādiṃ, tatrā'p'āsiṃ evaṃnāmo evaṃgotto evaṃvaṇṇo evam'āhāro evaṃ-sukhadukkha-ppaṭisaṃvedī evam'āyupariyanto, so tato cuto idh'ūpapanno'ti. iti sākāraṃ sauddesaṃ anekavihitaṃ pubbenivāsaṃ anussarati.

18198.meaning1: I am like that; I am the same
18198.commentary: (ANa) evaṃ'smī'ti idaṃ samato upanidhāya gahaṇaṃ, yath'āyaṃ khattiyo yath'āyaṃ brāhmaṇo, evam'aham'pī'ti attho.

examples.text: asmī'ti, bhikkhave, sati itth'asmī'ti hoti, evaṃ'smī'ti hoti, aññathā'smī'ti hoti, as'asmī'ti hoti, sat'asmī'ti hoti, santi hoti, itthaṃ santi hoti, evaṃ santi hoti, aññathā santi hoti
amutr'āsiṃ evaṃnāmo evaṃgotto evaṃvaṇṇo evam'āhāro evaṃsukhadukkhapaṭisaṃvedī evam'āyupariyanto, so tato cuto amutra udapādiṃ
